chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Salih ibn 'Uqbah, from 'Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far and Abu 'Abdillah عليهما السلام, both said:

Indeed, Fatimah عليها السلام, when there occurred from their affair what occurred, seized the collar of 'Umar and pulled him toward herself. Then she said: “Indeed, by Allah, O son of al-Khattab, were it not that I dislike affliction striking one who has no sin, you would know that I would surely swear upon Allah, then I would find Him swift in response.”

key_terms.أُقْسِمُ: I swear or invoke an oath before Allah
key_terms.الْبَلَاءُ: affliction or calamity that may descend upon people
key_terms.بِتَلَابِيبِ: by the collar or upper garment folds, indicating a forceful physical seizing
key_terms.سَرِيعَ الْإِجَابَةِ: swift in answering, referring to Allah's quick response to supplication
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fatimah عليها السلام, daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and central figure of the narration

ai.seo_question: What did Fatimah عليها السلام say to 'Umar when she confronted him after the events against her household?
ai.summary: This narration recounts a moment in which Fatimah عليها السلام confronted 'Umar during the events that transpired against her household. Her words express both the power of her du'a and her restraint, as she withheld invoking divine punishment out of concern that affliction might reach those without guilt.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> both having said:

‘(Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup>, when it was from their affair what was (Abu Bakr and Umar’s burning down her<sup>asws</sup> door etc.), she<sup>asws</sup> grabbed the collar of Umar and pulled him, then she<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, O son of Khattab! Had it not been for my<sup>asws</sup> dislike of the affliction hitting the ones who has not sin for him, you would have known that I<sup>asws</sup> would have sworn upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup> (for a curse to befall), then a quick Response would have been found’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn abu Nasr from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Salim from al-Faddal who has said the following. “I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), “Who washed Fatima (for burial)?” he said, “Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) did.”

My impression from his words seemed to be an extraordinary one. He said, “You seem to be constrained from what I said.” The narrator has said that I replied, “Yes, May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, it is so.” The narrator has said that the Imam (a.s.) then said, “Do not be constrained. She was the all truism person and no one has the authority to wash an all truism person but another all truism person. Did you not know that no one could wash Mary but Jesus.”
